newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle sales at $112 dressed-trade.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle sales at $112 dressed-trade.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle sold at $111.50 to $112.00 per cwt on a dressed basis in moderate activity near midday Wednesday, steady to $0.50 lower, compared with Tuesday's light sales and last week's top, market sources said.
About 10,000 head sold, with yearlings trading at $111.50 to $112.00 and calf-fed's discounted to $110.00, they said.

Yearlings go on feed more developed and at a heavier weight (700-800 lbs) and grade and yield better than calves, or calf-feds, that are younger and weigh less (500-600 lbs) when they go on feed, they said.
Sales also were reported at $68.00 to $69.00 on a live basis, steady to $1.00 lower, compared with Tuesday.
